title: Advancing Cardiovascular Risk Identification with Structured Clinical Documentation and Biosignal Derived Phenotypes Synthesis (ACRIBiS) as part of the medical informatics initiative
summary:
The overall medical picture of a person helps medical doctors to better identify their patients' personal health risks. This enables them to personalize preventive and therapeutic measures in each individual case and provide each patient with the best possible care. Supporting this personalization in cardiovascular medicine with highly complex data analyses - that is the aim of the ACRIBiS project funded by the Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF). 
Using state-of-the-art IT processes, complex biosignals, such as ECG data, are combined with clinical information - i.e. blood pressure values, treatment regimens and therapy results - in a large data pool. A medical prognosis model is developed from this wealth of data using complex data analyses. This model should be able to predict health risks for any person with cardiovascular disease with a high degree of reliability. In future, it should help those treating patients to identify potential risks more quickly and take targeted countermeasures at an early stage. With this tool, heart failure and heart attacks, for example, should be prevented more effectively in future.
conditions: At least one of the following diagnoses  o Diagnosis of manifest arteriosclerotic cardiovascular disease in the medical history as defined below: Acute myocardial infarction (ICD: I21), acute coronary syndrome (ICD: I24), coronary and arterial revascularization (bypass surgery (OPS: 5-361, 5-362), vascular angioplasty (OPS: 8-836.0, 8-36.1, 836. 2)), proven arteriosclerosis in imaging (coronary angiography (OPS: 1-275), arterial ultrasound), stroke (ICD: I63), TIA (ICD: G45.9), aortic aneurysm (ICD: I71), peripheral arterial occlusive disease (ICD: I70.2) o Documented atrial fibrillation (ICD: I48) (ECG or Holter recordings) within the last 12 months or with index hospitalization o Chronic heart failure (ICD: I50) according to the European Society of Cardiology guideline

interventions.name:
Documentation of the structured medical history and documentation of diagnoses, biosignals (automatically analyzed ECG data), therapies, medication as part of the clinical routine.
